intro: Ask about your code or review an edit.
boundary: Runtime sandbox: read-only. Reviewed edits change existing text buffers only after your approval. You or editor autosave control saving. New files, deletion and rename are not supported yet.
coexistence: Do not open this chat in another Codex client while it is in use here.
account: Using this machine’s Codex CLI sign-in
accountApiKey: Using this machine’s Codex CLI API key sign-in (usage-based API billing)
accountProvider: Using the model provider configured for this machine’s Codex CLI
signedOut: No sign-in was found for this machine’s Codex CLI. Run `codex login` in a terminal, then check again.
noHistory: No chats in this workspace yet.
question: Your input is needed
blocked: This runtime action needs broader permissions. Use reviewed text proposals for edits; escalation is disabled.
reviewHelp: Nothing has been applied. Select replacements, preview the diff, then apply. Changing the source file will invalidate this proposal.
sendEnterHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
catalog: Model catalog; access is verified only by a successful turn.
newRequired: Create a new chat or open a chat owned by this extension to send.
truncated: This item exceeds the 200,000 character display limit. Copy is unavailable; the full item remains in Codex history.
imageTooLarge: Images must be 10 MB or smaller.
imageType: Paste PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images.
imageAsText: Pasted as text. To attach the clipboard image instead, copy the image alone and paste again.
pasteCleaned: Removed {count} invisible control characters from the pasted text. Review it before sending.
contextUnavailable: This file or selection cannot be included. Choose one workspace text selection or use Add file.
autoContextNote: Current editor context is included on send.
contextHint: Add a file or select code in the editor.
fileSearchFailed: File search is unavailable. Try Add file.
moreFileMatches: Results are limited. Type more of the path to narrow the search.
emptyGroup: No loaded conversations in this group.
skillsHelp: Discover, enable and explicitly use skills provided by your Codex runtime.
mcpHelp: Manage Codex user connections and inspect their effective status.
connectIntegrations: Connect this tab to load Skills and MCP servers.
integrationUnknown: A configuration request has an unknown outcome. Refresh to reconcile before changing it again.
noSkills: No enabled matching skills. Refresh or enable a skill in Skills.
mcpBoundary: MCP tools may access external services or modify data outside the workspace. Local text-edit review does not cover those actions. Enable only trusted servers.
mcpReconnectHelp: Enabling, disabling or removing a server reconnects idle sessions. Reconnect after external configuration changes. Changes are blocked while any tab is working. Project and managed connections are read-only.
managedMcp: This configuration is owned by a project or administrator. You can only allow or block it in this workspace.
mcpSignInHelp: Enable and trust this server before signing in.
externalTools: external tools are outside text-edit review
nativeHelp: Codex runs with its native tools, sandbox and approvals. Ask before edits shows each change for review before it is written.
followupHelp: Follow-ups send only this text. File and Skill attachments are used by Send after this turn. Queued input uses this task’s runtime settings; finish or remove it before changing settings.
ecosystemHelp: Shared Codex configuration. Changes reconnect idle chats. Native agents use configured tools and trusted hooks; reviewed chats keep their restricted policy.
noAgents: No standalone custom agent TOML files. Built-in Codex agents remain available when enabled.
approvalSession: This root may remain writable for the rest of this session.
approvalTruncated: Details exceed the display limit. Approval is disabled.
hookUnsupported: This runtime does not execute prompt/agent hook handlers.
agentTasksHelp: Native child agents of this chat. Viewing output never resumes a task. Stop interrupts only the selected current turn. The parent can keep waiting; switch to Chat to stop the parent if needed.
memoryBrowserHelp: Read-only local Codex memory files on this machine, shared across projects. These are generated records, separate from ChatGPT web memory. Content is loaded only when opened and is never automatically attached to a prompt.
localListLimited: Showing a bounded list. Narrow the search or inspect the original local store for older entries.
noAgentTasks: No child agents found. Refresh after asking Codex to delegate a task.
noMemoryFiles: No local Markdown memory files found.
authPending: Complete sign-in in your browser. Credentials stay with the native Codex runtime.
authSuccess: Native sign-in completed. Reconnect sessions to refresh their authentication.
authFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Reconnect before trying again.
authUnknown: Sign-in outcome is unconfirmed. Reconnect before starting another flow.
agentsUncertain: Some child tasks could not be reconciled. Refresh or reconnect before changing shared settings.
cliChecking: Checking the existing Codex CLI sign-in…
cliReuseHelp: Connect to reuse this machine’s Codex CLI sign-in. To sign in or switch accounts, run `codex login` in a terminal.
mcpFormHelp: Answers go to this MCP server. Do not enter passwords, access tokens or other secrets. Nothing is sent until you submit.
formIncomplete: Complete the required fields and check the allowed values.
usageHelp: Account limits are shared across this account. Values come from the native Codex runtime; missing data is unavailable.
usageStale: Limits changed. Refresh for the current snapshot.
contextUsageHelp: Latest request tokens are not an exact measure of context occupancy. Totals cover the current native chat; cached and reasoning tokens are subsets. Historical totals appear only when the runtime sends an update.
modelUnavailable: Your configured model or reasoning effort is not in this Codex CLI's catalog. Pick a model below, or update the CLI (npm install -g @openai/codex) if your Codex config names a newer model. Your configuration has not been changed.
acceptSessionEdits: Accept all edits in this chat
diffHint: Review each file in the diff editor, then accept or reject here or from the editor title bar.
rewindHelp: Remove this message and everything after it, and restore Codex file edits recorded since then
historyResumeHelp: Continuing may run queued work. Close other writing clients first.
modelFallback: Your Codex config uses {requested}, which this Codex CLI does not offer. Using {used}; update the CLI (npm install -g @openai/codex) to use it.
emptyHint: Ask about this workspace. Codex shows file changes for review before writing them.
sideHelp: Ask about this chat without changing it. The side question uses a temporary read-only copy of the conversation; its answers are not added to the main chat and are discarded when you close it.
terminalsHelp: Commands the agent left running in this chat. Stopping one ends that process; it does not undo what it already did.
terminalsEmpty: No background terminals are running in this chat.
planProceedHelp: Runs the saved plan revision you confirm. Unsaved edits block it.
voiceUnsupported: This VS Code window cannot record audio.
approvalTitle: How should Codex actions be approved?
approval_review_help: Every file change waits for your review before it is written
approval_ask_help: Always ask to edit external files and use the internet
approval_auto_help: Only ask for actions detected as potentially unsafe
approval_full_help: Unrestricted access to the internet and any file on your computer
addImagesHelp: Attach PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images
goalHelp: Set a goal to keep pursuing
projectless: No folder is open, so Codex works in {path}. Open a folder to work on a project.

hubFocusHint: Hide tool activity and show only messages
hubDiagnosticsHint: Collect a report for bug reports
